content.rendered:
“And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,” (Luke 8: 43)

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

The woman with the issue of blood spent all her resources on physicians. These physicians would have posed as people who could be of help to her situation, but all they did was to take money from her without giving value back to her; she spent resources without getting solutions/results; she spent money with the expectation of results, but the results she desired remained elusive for twelve years. It was a clear case of wasted efforts.

Friend, hear me as I hear the Lord: the season of wasted efforts in your life, is over. The season of spending without results, is over; the season of labour without commensurate results, is over; the season of working hard and having nothing to show for it, is over; the season of doing your best for clients without earning anything in return, is over; the season of having the best of ideas without results to show for it, is over; the season of efforts without reasonable results, is over.

Ever power of hell that is making your efforts fruitless, I command the siege to be broken. Every plot of the enemy to reduce your efforts to rubbles, I command it to scatter by fire; every satanic altar that is speaking against your efforts and insisting that the efforts will not yield results, I send the fire of God to consume it; every satanic siege on your efforts, is broken.

Henceforth, your efforts will yield maximum results; your efforts will take you higher and higher; your efforts will position you on the mountain of relevance and influence; your efforts will cause you to be in the news for the right reasons; your efforts will push you forward; your efforts shall yield profit for you; your efforts will make a positive difference in your life.

The season of wasted efforts, is over for good. Henceforth, every effort shall yield amazing results.

Psalm 124: 7 says: “Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.”

Declare With Me: The cycle of wasted efforts in my life, is broken forever, in Jesus’ name!
